test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

Mother told Avika that those flowers were not to be thrown that day.

options.text: Mother said to Avika, “Don’t throw those flowers today.”
Mother said to Avika, “These flowers were not to be thrown that day.”
Mother said to Avika, “Those flowers were not to be thrown that day.”
Mother said to Avika, “These flowers are not to be thrown today.”

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is__ **Mother said to Avika, “These flowers are not to be thrown today.”**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To change from Indirect to Direct Speech, keep the rules of the Direct Speech are applied in reverse order.
 
• Use the reporting verb, "say"," said to", or "said" in its correct tense.
 
• Remove the conjunctions "that, to, if or whether etc". wherever necessary.
 
• Insert quotation marks, question mark, exclamation, and full stop, wherever necessary.
 
• Put a comma before the statement.
 
• Change the past tense into present tense wherever the reporting verb is in the past tense.
 
• Convert the past perfect either into past tense or present perfect as found necessary.
 
• Be careful about the order of words in the question.

 

​So, the final sentence is: Mother said to Avika, “These flowers are not to be thrown today.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Words expressing nearness in time or places are generally changed into words expressing distance.
